risk.rationale: No verified findings survive. Both suspicious signals were rejected with sound reasoning: the OWA forwarding rule targets an internal @aegean.edu archive address (not exfiltration), and the 193.140.10.9 activity is explained as shared-egress background noise (187 distinct accounts completed MFA from that IP in 30 days; failures across 68 accounts are not a coordinated spray). No data-quality conflicts, no exposure, no confirmed account takeover chain. Suspicious signals are fully explained away.
